title: Injection-ratio laser noise transfer
timing_contract: The −30 and −15 dB spectra were developed with four complete log-frequency-band folds; the entire −20 dB spectrum was reserved. Both ratio conditions remain in each development training fold. Confirmation therefore adds ratio interpolation beyond the spectral-band validation used for selection.
calibration: No held-ratio calibration. Log10 target transform fixed; measuredPSD only and100<=f<=1e6Hz.
independent_unit: Complete injection ratio; one laser/resonator setup. Development validation blocks complete log-frequency bands across two ratios.
scope_limits: Complete injection ratio; one laser/resonator setup. Development validation blocks complete log-frequency bands across two ratios.

A compact sum of feedback-sensitive and common noise contributions predicts the reserved injection ratio, but the selected extension loses to the simpler fixed-exponent domain control. This supports bounded reproduction and model ambiguity, not a new laser-noise law.
No independent population confidence interval from dependent rows.

exposure.historical: Internal confirmation reserved until FREEZE.json; schema-stage exposures documented in SOURCE_AND_UNITS.md.
exposure.current: All confirmation outcomes exposed to future users.

uncertainty_policy: Report individual top-level groups and their range; no row-bootstrap population inference.
aggregation: Equal group weight then equal eligible rows within group.
eligibility: Nonfinite native values excluded with anchors; none excluded by fit residuals. All source bytes unchanged.
native_adapter: native.py at scenario research root; shared benchmark integration supplies canonical adapter registration
reference_selection: Min primary error with simpler coefficient count within1percent; retain all controls even if superior.
physical_bounds: RawPSD positive; logarithmic target can be negative.
